basic_information.official_title: AN ACT CONVERTING THE IRANON DISTRICT HOSPITAL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARANG, PROVINCE OF MAGUINDANAO DEL NORTE INTO A PROVINCIAL HOSPITAL TO BE KNOWN AS THE IRANON PROVINCIAL HOSPITAL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after complete publication in a newspaper of regional circulation
basic_information.title_note: The short title as enacted reads “Iranon Provincial Hospital Act of 2023”, although the act was passed in May 2025 and approved in July 2025.

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Converts the Iranon District Hospital in Parang, Maguindanao del Norte into a 200-bed provincial hospital — with a three-year deadline for the upgrade and an annual progress report to Parliament.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: To raise a district hospital to provincial level and scale its capacity, staff and facilities to match.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: Bed capacity rises to 200. Doctors, nurses and support staff must increase in step, with new plantilla positions determined and filled. The whole upgrade must be delivered within 3 years, and the Ministry of Health must report annually to the Chief Minister and Parliament on progress.
who_will_be_affected: Residents of Parang and the wider province
Doctors, nurses, midwives and support staff, whose numbers must rise with the beds
Parliament, which receives an annual progress report
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2025 — 15 days after complete publication.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: NOW LAW. Iranon District Hospital becomes a 200-bed provincial hospital — and unlike earlier hospital acts, this one sets a three-year deadline and requires annual reports to Parliament.
in_practice: Converted from district to provincial hospital, under the direct supervision and control of the Ministry of Health
Existing workforce — doctors, nurses, support personnel — increased in proportion to the beds
Additional plantilla positions determined by MOH with the finance ministry and the Civil Service Commission, in consultation with hospital management
The upgrade must be implemented over 3 years from the act's approval
₱50,000,000 initial, charged against the 2025 Bangsamoro budget
Implementing rules within 60 days, in consultation with the Provincial Government of Maguindanao del Norte
An annual report on the outcome and progress of the conversion goes to the Chief Minister and to Parliament

for_specific_groups.Patients: Provincial-level care with 200 beds, rather than a district facility.
for_specific_groups.Health workers: Section 5 requires the workforce to grow with the bed count, and new permanent posts to be created and filled.
for_specific_groups.Anyone tracking delivery: Section 9 is the one to use — an annual report to the Committee on Health and the Committee on Finance, Budget and Management.

what_this_means_for_you.when_you_will_feel_it: The upgrade is to be implemented over 3 years from approval in July 2025.
what_you_can_do: Ask for the annual report to Parliament on the conversion's outcome and progress
Ask the Ministry of Health about the implementing rules, due within 60 days
Note the three-year implementation clock running from approval
watch_out_for: ₱50 million is an initial amount for a 200-bed conversion; the rest depends on annual appropriations.
The short title dates the act to 2023 although it was passed in 2025.
No sanction attaches if the three-year deadline is missed.

key_terms_explained.Provincial hospital: A facility serving a whole province, above district level in the referral chain.
key_terms_explained.Plantilla position: A permanent, funded post in the government staffing structure.
key_terms_explained.Hospital development plan: The document, prepared here by the Chief of Hospital, on which further expansion depends.
key_terms_explained.COH / CFBM: The Parliament's Committee on Health and Committee on Finance, Budget and Management, which receive the annual report.

what_this_means_for_you.status_note: Passed Dhul Qa'dah 21, 1446 / 19 May 2025, approved by Chief Minister Abdulraof A. Macacua on 9 July 2025.

direct_benefits.who_gets_it: Residents of Parang and Maguindanao del Norte

direct_benefits.benefit: More doctors, nurses, midwives and support staff
direct_benefits.how_to_access: Plantilla positions determined by MOH with MFBM and the Civil Service Commission

where_to_complain.oversight: Ministry of Health – BARMM, with direct supervision and control; Parliament's Committee on Health and Committee on Finance, Budget and Management receive the annual report
where_to_complain.note: The act creates no complaints procedure, but the annual report is a document a citizen can ask for.

everyday_scenarios: A patient in Parang previously referred out of the province for provincial-level care should find it locally once the conversion is delivered.

A resident asking whether the upgrade is on schedule can point to Section 9, which requires an annual report on outcome and progress to Parliament, and Section 6, which sets a three-year implementation period.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Short title: the “Iranon Provincial Hospital Act of 2023”.

Section 2 — Converts the Iranon District Hospital in Parang, Maguindanao del Norte into a 200-bed capacity provincial hospital, the Iranon Provincial Hospital, under the direct supervision and control of the Ministry of Health.
Section 3 — Authorised bed capacity is increased to 200. Any future increase must be consistent with a hospital development plan prepared by the Chief of Hospital and submitted to the MOH.
Section 4 — Existing professional health care services and facilities are upgraded to conform with and be commensurate to the increase in bed capacity.

Section 5 — The existing workforce, including doctors, nurses and support personnel, shall be increased corresponding to the increase in bed capacity. The MOH, coordinating with the Ministry of Finance, and Budget and Management and the Civil Service Commission, and consulting hospital management, shall determine the additional plantilla positions to be created and filled up.
Section 6 — The upgrade of professional health care services and facilities, including the workforce increase, shall be implemented over a period of 3 years from the approval of the act.

Section 7 — An initial ₱50,000,000 is charged against the 2025 General Appropriation Act of the Bangsamoro, with funds for operations thereafter included in the annual appropriations for the year following enactment.
Section 8 — Within 60 days of effectivity the MOH shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations, in consultation with the Provincial Government of Maguindanao del Norte and other stakeholders.

Section 9 — The MOH shall submit to the Chief Minister and to Parliament, through the Committee on Health and the Committee on Finance, Budget and Management, an annual report on the outcome and progress of the conversion.
Section 12 — Takes effect 15 days following complete publication in a newspaper of regional circulation.

who_benefits: Residents of Parang and Maguindanao del Norte

citizen_questions.a: 200 beds, converted from a district hospital to a provincial one.
Yes — 3 years from the act's approval for the upgrade of services, facilities and workforce. That is unusual; most hospital acts in the registry set none.

Section 5 requires the workforce — doctors, nurses and support personnel — to increase in proportion to the beds, with new plantilla positions determined by the health ministry with the finance ministry and the Civil Service Commission.

The Ministry of Health must submit an annual report on the outcome and progress of the conversion to the Chief Minister and to Parliament, through the Committee on Health and the Committee on Finance, Budget and Management.
